items.title: Update to ArcGIS Pro Product Life Cycle
items.summary: Beginning with the release of ArcGIS Pro 3.8 (November 2026), we are updating the ArcGIS Pro product life cycle (PLC) to make software support easier to understand, simplify upgrade planning, and improve alignment with the ArcGIS Enterprise life cycle.

items.title: Supporting independent journalism in Ukraine

items.title: An Alien Mind
items.summary: Author: Jakub Pachocki, Chief Scientist at OpenAI In mid-2023, within the “RLSlow” research project, we saw the first results that gave us confidence that we will be able to scale the training of reasoning models, unlocking the capability of pretrained models to form their own chains of thought.

items.title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
items.summary: For AGI to benefit all of humanity, we believe it must be democratically governed.

items.title: The EU AI Compliance Stack Is Crystallizing Into Three Layers – and None of Them Talk to Each Other
items.summary: The European Union’s approach to regulating artificial intelligence has moved beyond the singular focus of the EU AI Act , crystallizing instead into an unsynchronized, three-layer compliance stack.
